## Hypothesis

The shotgun_scalper_stage2 grinder identified a parameter set that shifts focus from J's anchor days to non-J days, achieving high win rate (57%) and strong average trade profit ($12.28) by tightening exits (50% TP, 30% stop, 10-min time stop) and using OTM-2 strikes with volume confirmation. The hypothesis is that this avoids J's loser days while capturing consistent non-J day edge, despite sacrificing J winner day P&L.

## Mechanism

**Entry:**  
- Strike offset: OTM-2 puts (strike_offset=2)  
- Volume filter: vol_ratio_threshold=1.2 (require 1.2x average volume)  

**Exit:**  
- Take profit: tp_premium_pct=0.5 (exit 2/3 at 50% premium gain)  
- Stop loss: stop_premium_pct=-0.3 (catastrophe cap at 30% premium loss)  
- Time stop: time_stop_min=10 (exit by entry+10min if no other signal)  
- Profit lock: chandelier_arm_pct=0.5 (trail stop activates at 50% profit)  

*Note: Baseline parameters unknown; changes relative to Stage-1 default combo ({}).*
